requirements.text: The system shall use the Globus toolkit.
The system shall provide a graphical user interface to all functions of the system.
The web portal components shall integrate into the Dataportal Web Server at NCAR
The compute node software shall be developed and deployed for the Hemisphere Linux cluster at CU
The system shall provide a web based (portal) user interface for all aspects of the system.
The system shall use the NCAR Mass Storage System for all file based storage.
All GridBGC users shall be required to have valid NCAR Gatekeeper accounts to use the system.
The system shall retrieve all user information from the Gatekeeper account system.
The system shall support the following user roles: User and Administrator.
The system shall provide a means to request that the user account be deleted from the system.
The system shall require the user to enter their username and password to login to the system.
The system shall lock the account after 3 login attempts.
The system shall allow portal administrators the ability to control template submissions rights.
The system shall assign all user accounts to the scientist role by default.
The system shall prevent the user from changing object/project values once that project has been used in a model run.
The system shall support 3 types of objects: List, Grid, and Parameterization.
The system shall require the users enable cookies to use the system.
The system shall allow users the ability to store data on the NCAR Mass Storage System.
The system shall enforce TLS 1.2 or higher for all data in transit between the client, web portal, and compute nodes.

The system shall implement an automated reconciliation service that attempts to restore missing file references from backup snapshots or logs, and provides a detailed audit report for manual intervention if restoration fails.

The system shall implement a deterministic state machine where any modification to a parent object automatically triggers a cascading invalidation of all dependent child objects, preventing the use of stale or inconsistent data.
Define specific latency targets for UI interactions (e.g., < 2s for page loads) and throughput/execution time targets for model runs on the compute cluster.
Define the required accuracy of the execution time estimate and the performance monitoring frequency for compute nodes.

OPEN: The PRD mentions NCAR security policies but does not define how the application will audit access or administrative actions. - The system shall maintain an immutable audit log of all administrative actions, including account approvals, role assignments, and job terminations.

OPEN: The PRD lacks a requirement for session management security beyond enabling cookies. - The system shall implement secure session management, including the use of 'Secure' and 'HttpOnly' flags on all session cookies and automatic session timeout after 15 minutes of inactivity.

OPEN: The PRD does not specify how the system handles authorization for shared objects, potentially leading to unauthorized data access. - The system shall implement an Access Control List (ACL) mechanism that validates user permissions before granting read or write access to any shared object or project.

OPEN: The PRD fails to define the behavior of the system when the NCAR Mass Storage System (MSS) is unavailable or experiences latency, which is a critical dependency. - The system shall implement a local caching layer or a retry-queue mechanism to handle transient failures of the NCAR Mass Storage System without losing user data or terminating active jobs.

OPEN: The PRD does not specify how the system handles partial failures or job interruptions during long-running scientific simulations on remote compute nodes. - The system shall implement checkpointing for all model runs to allow for resumption after transient compute node failures or network interruptions.

OPEN: The PRD lacks information regarding the expected number of concurrent users, total data volume, or the number of simultaneous model runs the system must support. - Specify the expected concurrent user load and the total storage capacity required for the NCAR Mass Storage System integration.
